data.exact_reserve_text:
Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 14.5m (2016: GBP 11.1m).
There has also been some strengthening of prior year reserves, predominantly affecting the Agriculture, Professional Liability and Financial Institutions classes.

named_events.loss_description: The combined impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria on the Syndicate was GBP 19.8m ($25.5m) on a net basis (excluding reinstatement premiums).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased materially in 2017. The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of claims provisions of GBP 151.6m (33.2% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by adverse reserve development and large loss / catastrophe activity. The Managing Agent specifically notes catastrophe impacts in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) and strengthening of prior year reserves in classes including Agriculture, Professional Liability and Financial Institutions. A smaller net adverse prior year development is recorded in the technical P&L narrative, but the gross movement in the technical provisions note is the primary measure used here.
raw_causal_phrases: The increase in the net loss ratio to 67.2% (2016: 59.3%) is driven by catastrophe events.
The combined impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria on the Syndicate was GBP 19.8m ($25.5m) on a net basis (excluding reinstatement premiums).
There has also been some strengthening of prior year reserves, predominantly affecting the Agriculture, Professional Liability and Financial Institutions classes.
Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 14.5m (2016: GBP 11.1m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement used is the GROSS 'Change in prior year provisions' from the Technical Provisions note (gross GBP 151.607m) and is taken as authoritative. The P&L narrative reports a much smaller NET adverse prior year development (GBP 14.5m) - this is net of reinsurance and represents a different metric. Per-line gross prior-year movements are not provided in the technical provisions note; a per-line prior-year table exists but appears to show net figures with ambiguous sign formatting. The per-LOB amounts included above are taken from the prior year claims development table (net figures) and carry lower confidence. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and has been captured in _claims_triangle for cross-checking.
